questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a diamond shape, black markings, and a yellow background. It tells drivers that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It tells you a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a diamond-shaped warning sign with black markings on a yellow background. It warns you that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help riders communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it signals other riders to increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make space for vehicles entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop if needed. Let vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first. You must stop if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that people may be crossing the road. Watch for pedestrians in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it signals a right turn. Use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals to communicate your intentions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has several turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means that action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal tells other riders to follow you. Hand signals are important for communication when riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be prepared to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow. An island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Look and listen for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will curve sharply. Slow down before the turn just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and crossing traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down, it signals following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic from other directions.
